notes.title: The new version of 'Free World' is online!!!
notes.notes:
Version update content
1. New feature for corner selection and creation
1.1. Each role is independent
1.2. Increase character display for casting selection
1.3 Interface Reset
2. Role model optimization update
3. Equipment model optimization update
4. Animal model optimization update

Version update content
1. Map major update
2. Increase villages
3. Add NPCs
4. Add NPC tasks and redeem rewards
5. Add gemstone function
6. Increase equipment level and gem level enhancement
7. Increase check-in rewards
8. Add the layout of Chapter 2
9. Add a second chapter on monsters and drops
10. Adjust various values within the game

Version update content
1. Optimize online parameters
2. Add detailed equipment functions
3. Add equipment column display

Version update content
Urgently fix erroneous data

Version update content
1. Fixed the black screen issue in the game
2. Modify the backpack UI to avoid being too blocked
3. Increase the speed of tree cutting and mining
4. Newly added basic merchant materials and strengthened synthetic routes such as future inlay

Version update content
Optimized game performance and solved the long-standing problem of game lag

Version update content
Change the game version number so that the game can be updated on the platform.

Version update content
Urgently fix bugs and vulnerabilities

Version update content
1. Add online mode. Operation: For console players, the invitation code will be displayed at the top of the main interface. Join the player and enter the corresponding host invitation code in the selection interface.
You can join a group to contact friends and play online together.
2. Map major update. Terrain, monsters, props, etc.
3. Optimize and improve functionality. Fishing, digging, backpacks, etc.

Version update content
1. Adjust the numerical value
2. Optimize the code to prepare for future online deployment

Version update content
1. Add a map system that allows real-time viewing of player locations.
2. Add iron sword, battle axe, and good bow, and strengthen by+2 and+3.
3. Change the transmission logic of the replica portal to non scene switching.
4. Store and exchange can purchase reinforced stones.

Version update content
1. Enhance equipment with sticks, spears, forks, bows, and slingshots.
2. It can be strengthened at the forging master's place.
3. The material box can be used to purchase reinforced stones.

Version update content
1. Enhance the characteristics of sticks, spears, and forks, and adjust their numerical balance. Significantly increase the value of slingshot
2. Reduce the iron sword attack, enhance the battle axe attack, and significantly increase the speed of the good bow attack
3. Add weapons and defenses, with specific numerical descriptions
4. Add item enhancement stone I, which can strengthen iron and leather weapons
5. Increase the health and attack power of the dungeon boss. Increase the number of coins dropped by bosses and strengthen props
6. Increase the number of instance monsters and increase the drop of coins
7. Increase turtle fragments and exchange them for turtle mounts
8. Optimize the entrance position of the replica
9. Increase the function of building roads and canals
10. Adjust manufacturing UI to be sliding
